title: Portable agent identity and authority — revision-locked blind challenge

official_sources.title: Software and AI Agent Identity and Authorization concept paper, February 2026

tasks.scenario: A recorded MCP read names the active task, exact allowed resource and destination, current policy epoch, valid short-lived identity fixture, and available independent monitor.
A valid MCP client token is attached for passthrough to a downstream tool even though the resource server must receive its own audience-bound token.
The credential signature is valid, but its task identifier belongs to yesterday's completed work while the request names today's task.
All request bindings match, but the monitor required by the authority lease is unavailable before the recorded action.
An A2A message targets an approved peer, but the retrieved Agent Card digest differs from the one bound to the active authority envelope.
A recorded A2A task-status read names the approved peer, current card digest, exact task and operation, live lease, and current per-request authorization.
